sentences.text: Atlantidosteus is an extinct homostiid arthrodire discovered in Morocco and Queensland during the Early to Middle Devonian.
The genus Atlantidosteus was formally described by Lelièvre in 1984.
This animal belongs to the class Placodermi, a parent group called Arthrodira.
It sits within the clade Migmatocephala and is more closely related to Homostius than to Antineosteus.
Fossils of this species date from the Emsian to the Eifelian stages.
